desc: Implement direct O(N) closed-form solution for maximum H via prefix/suffix minima.
Use 0-based indexing consistently for U_j - X*j and U_j + X*j; include j=i in both scans.
Compute answer as total - N*bestH using Python arbitrary-precision integers.
Check edge cases: already fitting teeth, very large X, large answers, and N=2.
If the closed-form approach fails sample tests, fall back to binary search on H with interval propagation.
